cause: Pinned NVIDIA converter rejects resolved video paths beneath /dev, including /dev/shm. It stopped before producing training v2.1 video files.

partial_training_v2.preservation: Retain inactive partial output with explicit failure provenance during recovery.

recovery: Use fresh configurable external-disk staging for the unchanged pinned v3-to-v2 converter, then hash-verify copies back to RAM. Preserve completed v3 and source recordings. No data exclusion, re-encoding of completed training videos, or upstream path-guard bypass.
